title: Right atrium
description: Receives oxygen-poor blood returning from the body.

title: Left atrium
description: Receives oxygen-rich blood returning from the lungs.

title: Right ventricle
description: Pumps blood through the pulmonary artery towards the lungs.

title: Left ventricle
description: Pumps blood into the aorta for the body.

title: Septum
description: Separates the right and left sides of the heart.

title: Venae cavae
description: Return blood from the upper and lower body to the right atrium.

title: Pulmonary artery
description: Carries oxygen-poor blood from the right ventricle to the lungs.

title: Pulmonary veins
description: Return oxygen-rich blood from the lungs to the left atrium.

title: Aorta
description: Carries oxygen-rich blood from the left ventricle to the body.

title: Tricuspid valve
description: Prevents backflow from the right ventricle into the right atrium.

title: Mitral valve
description: Prevents backflow from the left ventricle into the left atrium.

title: Pulmonary valve
description: Prevents backflow from the pulmonary artery into the right ventricle.

title: Aortic valve
description: Prevents backflow from the aorta into the left ventricle.
